ASTOLFORIDER-ASTOLFO.title: Astolfo
ASTOLFORIDER-ASTOLFO.description: Follow a changing Caprice, gather Critical Stars with Quick cards, and escape danger aboard Hippogriff.
ASTOLFORIDER-ASTOLFO.goldMonologue: An adventure needs snacks, ribbons, and at least one terrible map!
ASTOLFORIDER-ASTOLFO.aromaPrinciple: The best path is whichever one becomes an adventure.
ASTOLFORIDER-ASTOLFO.banter.alive.endTur: Don't worry! I only forgot half the plan.
ASTOLFORIDER-ASTOLFO.banter.dead.endTurn: Keep going. Adventures are meant to be finished!
